### Central Pacific Financial Corp. Announces Conference Call to Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 7, 2026


HONOLULU--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Central Pacific Financial Corp. (NYSE: CPF), parent company of Central Pacific Bank, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on October 28, 2026, before the market opens. Management will review the results by conference call and live audio webcast beginning at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Hawaii Time) on October 28, 2026.


Interested parties may listen to the conference by calling 1-833-461-5787 (Meeting ID: 104 617 134), or by registering for the webcast at the following link:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/104617134](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.proofpoint.com%2Fv2%2Furl%3Fu%3Dhttps-3A__events.q4inc.com_attendee_104617134%26d%3DDwMFaQ%26c%3DGjPuZObciCkPG6u1AXziy2kK-97HmvbqslnBCdReQX4%26r%3D6NZJR3LOWiJwMkHrPIscCl90yZDGSRulTZgKmEQXM2Q%26m%3Dypnsh1cVUMAffb_EbvdeXClRLCK52EiQxd5_UZtMM54G-kSDrl1sSjPe-MMHClS6%26s%3DveXC_XV6cb-s132Y0nzGgP0dDghzzGbamcH5uTTVSlo%26e%3D&esheet=54617495&newsitemid=20261007611242&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F104617134&index=1&md5=25ffd81a3f90dffca6615a4b88a9a80f) . The Company’s investor relations website,[https://ir.cpb.bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.cpb.bank&esheet=54617495&newsitemid=20261007611242&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.cpb.bank&index=2&md5=a30b57eb6183706cd3068e26491cc012) , will also include a link to the webcast and a slide presentation.


A replay of the call will be available through October 28, 2027, on the Company’s investor relations website.


**About Central Pacific Financial Corp.**


Central Pacific Financial Corp. is a Hawaii-based bank holding company with approximately $7.50 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026. Central Pacific Bank, its primary subsidiary, operates 27 branches and 56 ATMs in the State of Hawaii. For additional information, please visit the Company's website at:[https://www.cpb.bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cpb.bank&esheet=54617495&newsitemid=20261007611242&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cpb.bank&index=3&md5=b21a3a8f54565afc16c64f8473775489)
